import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML‑formatted string ready for safe presentation on the webpage. Notes ----- - All user input is escaped to prevent XSS (CWE-79). - The function does not perform any additional filtering beyond escaping, which is sufficient for a plain text blog post. """ # Escape user-supplied data to avoid injection of malicious HTML/JS safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Replace placeholders in the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
